segments.name: Iron ore mining
segments.description: A pass-through royalty trust holding interests in Mesabi Iron Range lands, earning royalties from Northshore's iron ore mining operations.
segments.evidence: Substantially all of the revenue, operating profits and assets of the Trust relate to one business segment—iron ore mining.

revenueModel.text: The Trust is paid royalties by Northshore Mining Company (Cleveland-Cliffs) based on the amounts and sales prices of iron ore products shipped from Silver Bay, Minnesota.
revenueModel.evidence: The information regarding amounts and sales prices of shipped iron ore products is used to compute the royalties payable to the Trust by Northshore.
